criteria.text: Calculates the working capital shortfall as $910,000 and the adjusted Purchase Price as $184,090,000, identifying that the Seller's funds flow figure of $183,180,000 is wrong.

Identifies that the Larkspur Robotics Ltd contract (Clause 14.2) allows termination on a change of control without consent, that the disclosure against Warranty 6.3 says there is no such provision, and that consent should be obtained as a condition to Closing.
Calculates the long-stop date as 16 December 2026 (150 days after signing on 19 July 2026) and identifies that expected clearance on 30 January 2027 falls after it, recommending an extension.

Identifies the conflict between the 20-day claim notice period in SPA Section 9.7 and the 45-day period in Escrow Clause 5.2, and recommends the Buyer works to the shorter 20-day period or aligns the documents.
Calculates the Earn-out Payment as $3,900,000 (3 x ($5,300,000 - $4,000,000), subject to the $5,000,000 cap) and identifies that the Seller's figure of $3,500,000 is wrong.
Shows the adjustment arithmetic ($185,000,000 - $910,000 = $184,090,000) and flags the discrepancy.
Gives the long-stop period as 150 days and as the date 16 December 2026, with days remaining from 17 August 2026 (121 days).
Where a defined term or clause is ambiguous, explains how each alternative reading would work.
